description.value:
From Made in Heaven · Price: the aura speeds up everyone else's world but you, so allies in it are hit too.

Theme Time

  • 1: You gain a +10-ft status bonus to Speed. Twice per combat, 1 action: your stand is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{quickened} for 1 minute; it can use the extra action only to Stride, Step or Strike. This doesn't cost a Stand Point. Your stand's first Strike each turn comes at accelerated speed: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against it, and it deals 1 extra damage per weapon damage die.
  • 5: Surge, 1 action: you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{quickened} for 1 minute (the extra action only to Stride, Step or Strike, as haste). Every other creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-ft emanation}, allies included, attempts a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save or takes a –10-ft penalty to Speed for 1 round. Surge, 1 action: your stand Strikes at accelerated speed; the Strike deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage instead of its normal damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against it.
  • 9: The emanation is 20 ft, and creatures that fail are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to you.
  • 13: Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{quickened} action can be used for any action.
  • 17: Once per day, every other creature within 30 ft attempts a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round on a failure, 1 minute on a critical failure (incapacitation).

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.pCB4ICmqVO0RK9nv]{Effect: Accelerated World}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
